display_long_description:
Every match is a completely unique experience! Enemies spawn randomly in different positions, driven by an AI that decides whether to attack, flee, cast spells, or reposition. No two games are ever the same, and you will definitely break a sweat!

In just one match, you can experience true combat: throw real punches—the faster your swing, the more damage you deal!
Along the way, you can pick up weapons, or charge and cast powerful magic spells.

Can't move around? No problem! You can play seated, moving with the thumbsticks while throwing physical punches or slaps (simply touching the enemy isn't enough to hurt them). Jumping and kicking can be easily done using the controller buttons in this mode.

Important Calibration Tip:
When entering a scene, remember to stretch your arms forward and press down the thumbsticks to recalibrate your avatar. This calibration will also automatically rescale the enemies to properly match your height.


4 different game modes using the main menu checkboxes:

VR Mode: Leave the main "MR" checkbox off.

MR Mode: Turn on all 3 checkboxes.

XR Mode: Turn on the "MR" and "Avatar" checkboxes. The virtual arena disappears, and you fight enemies in your real-world environment using your virtual avatar.

AR Mode: Turn on only the "MR" checkbox. The arena and your avatar disappear, letting you fight enemies in reality with your actual hands.


5 difficulty levels.


For all other details, please refer to the "How to Play" section inside the game!
